title: Prime Big Deal Days 2026 ends tonight: 200 of the best deals to shop now
summary: Prime Big Deal Days ends tonight at 11:59 p.m. PDT (2:59 a.m. EDT Thursday). From tech and toys to kitchen, beauty, and fall fashion, here are the top deals to shop before the 48-hour event ends.
body_markdown:
---


## Key takeaways


- [Prime Big Deal Days 2026](https://www.aboutamazon.com/prime-big-deal-days) ends tonight at 11:59 p.m. PDT (2:59 a.m. EDT Thursday, October 8).


- Today's Big Deals drop three times daily, at midnight, 8 a.m., and 1 p.m. PDT (3 a.m., 11 a.m., and 4 p.m. EDT). Discounts reach up to 55% or more, most at Amazon's lowest price of the year so far.


- This list features more than 180 of the best Prime Big Deal Days deals still available across tech, home and kitchen, beauty, fashion, kids and toys, grocery, and fitness, with discounts up to 66% off. We're updating it throughout the end of the event.


- A Prime membership is required to shop Prime Big Deal Days deals. Prime costs $14.99 per month or $139 per year, and eligible customers can start a free 30-day trial.


---


Ready to kick off fall and holiday shopping? Prime Big Deal Days 2026 is officially here, giving Prime members 48 hours of deals across fashion, electronics, beauty, toys, home, and more—including everything you need for fall wardrobe refreshes, Halloween and game-day gatherings, and getting a head start on holiday gifting.


[8 Amazon AI features to help you find the best deals this Prime Big Deal Days](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-ai-shopping-tools)


Prime Big Deal Days 2026 starts on October 6, and these AI shopping tools can help you find, track, and score the best deals.


This year’s event, running through Wednesday, October 7, features deals at Amazon’s lowest prices of the year so far, with savings on top brands like LEGO, La Roche-Posay, and UGG. Today’s Big Deals are back with limited-time offers at up to 55% or more off, with new drops launching three times daily at midnight, 8 a.m., and 1 p.m. PDT.


We’ve rounded up some of the best deals available right now. We’ll keep updating this list throughout the event, so be sure to check back often.

## How to find the best Prime Big Deal Days deals


- Shop Today's Big Deals at each drop


: New limited-time deals launch at midnight, 8 a.m., and 1 p.m. PDT (3 a.m., 11 a.m., and 4 p.m. EDT) and are available only while supplies last. This year's drops include up to $2,000 off a big-screen TV from Sony and up to 50% off trending K-beauty from medicube and Dr.Jart+.


- Check Price History


: Tap "Price History" on any product detail page, or ask Alexa for Shopping, to see up to 365 days of pricing.


- Set a target price


: Alexa for Shopping can alert you when items on your Lists drop in price, and Auto-Buy can purchase an item automatically when it hits your target.


- Personalize your feed


: Set up Interests, from cooking to fitness, to see relevant deal recommendations.


All deals and availability are subject to change.

## What is Amazon Prime Big Deal Days?


Prime Big Deal Days is a Prime member-exclusive shopping event. The 2026 event officially started Tuesday, October 6 (12:01 a.m. PDT), and runs through Wednesday, October 7 (11:59 p.m. PDT), offering Prime members 48 hours of deals at Amazon’s lowest prices of the year so far across top brands and categories. Learn


[everything you need to know](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-big-deal-days-faq) about Prime Big Deal Days.


## Prime Big Deal Days 2026 FAQ


When does Prime Big Deal Days end?


The event ends at 11:59 p.m. PDT on Wednesday, October 7 (2:59 a.m. EDT on Thursday, October 8).


How long is Prime Big Deal Days?


Prime Big Deal Days 2026 lasts 48 hours, from 12:01 a.m. PDT on Tuesday, October 6, through 11:59 p.m. PDT on Wednesday, October 7.


What time do Today's Big Deals drop?


New Today's Big Deals launch three times daily at midnight, 8 a.m., and 1 p.m. PDT (3 a.m., 11 a.m., and 4 p.m. EDT), with discounts up to 55% or more. They're available only while supplies last.


How can I tell if a Prime Big Deal Days deal is a good price?


Tap "Price History" on any product detail page, or ask


[Alexa for Shopping](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/alexa-for-shopping-ai-assistant) , to see up to 365 days of pricing data for that item.


How is Prime Big Deal Days different from Prime Day?


Both are exclusive to Prime members.


[Prime Day](https://www.aboutamazon.com/prime-day) typically runs four days in the summer. Prime Big Deal Days is a two-day fall event designed to kick off holiday shopping, with seasonal savings on fall entertaining, Halloween, and gifting.


Do I need Prime to shop Prime Big Deal Days?


Yes. Prime costs $14.99 per month or $139 per year, and


[eligible customers can start a free 30-day trial](https://www.aboutamazon.com/news/retail/amazon-prime-free-trial) .


Can I shop Prime Big Deal Days outside the U.S.?


Yes. Prime members in 22 countries, including the U.S., can shop Prime Big Deal Days this season. Dates vary by country.
